name: Table
description: A compound table component built on native HTML table elements. Wrapped in a responsive overflow container. Provides styled sub-components for header, body, footer, rows, head cells, data cells, and captions with hover states and selection support.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with default 'w-full caption-bottom text-sm' styling.

subComponents.name: TableHeader
subComponents.description: Wraps table header rows in a <thead> element. Applies border-bottom to child rows.

subComponents.name: TableBody
subComponents.description: Wraps table body rows in a <tbody> element. Removes border from the last row.

subComponents.name: TableFooter
subComponents.description: Wraps table footer rows in a <tfoot> element. Styled with top border, muted/50 background, and medium font weight.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with 'border-t bg-muted/50 font-medium'.

subComponents.name: TableRow
subComponents.description: A table row (<tr>) with bottom border, hover highlight (muted/50), and selected state background via data-[state=selected].

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with 'border-b transition-colors hover:bg-muted/50 data-[state=selected]:bg-muted'.

subComponents.name: TableHead
subComponents.description: A table header cell (<th>) with h-10 height, left-aligned text, medium font weight, and muted-foreground color. Adjusts padding when containing a checkbox.

subComponents.name: TableCell
subComponents.description: A table data cell (<td>) with p-2 padding and middle vertical alignment. Adjusts padding when containing a checkbox.

subComponents.name: TableCaption
subComponents.description: A table caption (<caption>) positioned at the bottom with mt-4 margin, text-sm, and muted-foreground color.

accessibility.keyboard: Standard table navigation. Tab moves through interactive elements within cells.
accessibility.aria: Native HTML table semantics provide built-in accessibility. Row selection state is conveyed via data-[state=selected] attribute. Checkbox columns adjust layout automatically.
accessibility.notes: The table is wrapped in a 'relative w-full overflow-auto' container for horizontal scrolling on small screens. Use TableCaption to provide a summary of the table content for screen readers.
